kpis.description_fr: CA segment Healthcare (pulse oximetry, monitors, sensors). Désormais seul segment reporté post-cession Sound United (consumer audio).
kpis.description_en: Healthcare segment revenue (pulse oximetry, monitors, sensors). Sole reported segment post Sound United divestiture.

kpis.description_fr: Profit brut segment Healthcare - rentabilité du modèle deferred equipment + sensors récurrents.
kpis.description_en: Healthcare segment gross profit - profitability of deferred equipment + recurring sensors model.

kpis.description_fr: Engagements contractuels deferred equipment (>1 an) - indicateur visibilité revenus futurs sensors hôpitaux.
kpis.description_en: Deferred equipment contractual backlog (>1 year duration) - visibility on future sensor revenue from hospitals.

kpis.description_fr: Patients monitorés annuellement avec Masimo SET pulse oximetry (~200 millions). Mesure installed-base / pénétration clinique.
kpis.description_en: Patients monitored annually with Masimo SET pulse oximetry (~200M). Proxy for installed base / clinical penetration.

kpis.description_fr: Part Etats-Unis dans le CA Healthcare (~63%). Forte concentration géographique.
kpis.description_en: US share of Healthcare revenue (~63%). High geographic concentration.

kpis_story.description_fr: Cession Sound United (audio grand public) annoncée 2024-2025. Recentrage 100% santé/monitoring (SpO2, hemodynamie). Bataille gouvernance Politan résolue.
kpis_story.description_en: Sound United (consumer audio) divestiture announced 2024-2025. Refocus 100% on health/monitoring (SpO2, hemodynamics). Politan governance battle resolved.

_notes: Sound United (non-healthcare consumer audio, Bose-like Marantz/Polk) divested Sep 2025 to Samsung/Harman - now classified as discontinued ops. Single Healthcare segment going forward.
